content: Severe episodes of hypoglycemia are linked to an increased risk of cognitive decline or the development of dementia. Conversely, impaired cognitive function can elevate the likelihood of severe hypoglycemia, potentially due to a diminished ability to recognize and respond to hypoglycemic symptoms. To address this bidirectional relationship, healthcare providers may consider modifying glycemic targets or A1C goals to minimize the risk of hypoglycemia, especially in patients with cognitive impairments. For more comprehensive guidance on managing hypoglycemia in older adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes, refer to Section 13, titled Older Adults.
